hardwareHubs.note: Maker Works runs shops with CNC machines and laser cutters in Ann Arbor.
Centrepolis Accelerator at Lawrence Technological University serves physical product developers and manufacturers.

makerspaces.name: Maker Works
makerspaces.note: Lists CNC machines including a metal mill, laser cutters, and tools for wood, metal, textiles, plastic, jewelry and electronics.

programs.name: Centrepolis Accelerator
programs.note: Lawrence Technological University program offering product design, engineering and prototyping help, co-working space and mentors to physical product developers.

specialties.name: Automotive and mobility
specialties.note: An industry article describes Michigan moving from its auto base toward EV, battery and mobility work, with the American Center for Mobility as an autonomous vehicle test site.

specialties.name: Aerospace
specialties.note: The state business site says Michigan is home to more than 900 aerospace-related companies.

specialties.name: Defense
specialties.note: An industry article says Michigan has made targeted investments in defense and uncrewed systems.

support.name: Michigan Manufacturing Technology Center (MMTC)
support.note: NIST MEP center offering consulting in operational excellence, cybersecurity, Industry 4.0 and skill development to Michigan manufacturers.
